column1: 20864§reinstate§ˌriːɪnˈsteɪt§Whaley set up a festival to reinstate a sense of pride in their eco-heritage, and helped local schoolchildren plant thousands of trees.§惠利创办了一个节日，以**恢复**当地人们对其生态遗产的自豪感，并帮助当地学童种植了数千棵树。§
20865§statement§ˈsteɪtmənt§The statement contradicts the views of the writer.§这些**陈述**与作者的观点相反。§
20866§amount§əˈmaʊnt§The chart shows the amount spent on six consumer goods in European countries.§这张图表显示了欧洲国家在六种消费品上的**总**花费。§
20867§given§ˈɡɪvn§It is often important that you make it clear what your particular role is at a given time.§明确自己在**特定**时间内的特定角色通常很重要。§
20868§advanced§ədˈvɑːnst§Prehistoric Amazonians developed technology and art that were advanced for their time.§史前亚马孙人创造了当时**先进**的技术和艺术。§
20869§milestone§ˈmaɪlstəʊn§This theory represents one of the great milestones in the history of scientific thought.§这一理论是科学思想史上一座伟大的**里程碑**。§
20870§crank§kræŋk§That gear is connected to a crank which changes the motion.§那个传动装置与一个能改变运动方式的**曲柄**连接在一起。§
20871§lexicographer§ˌleksɪˈkɒɡrəfə(r)§The reform has transformed the way lexicographers work.§这种改革改变了**词典编纂者**的工作方式。§
20872§bunch§bʌntʃ§He picked me a bunch of flowers.§他给我采了一**束**花。§
20873§costume§ˈkɒstjuːm§Mom told me that she had a ballet costume.§妈妈告诉我她有一套芭蕾舞**服**。§
20874§scare§skeə(r)§The decoy camera can be fixed to the wall to scare off burglars.§可以在墙上安装假摄像头来**吓**走盗贼。§
20875§manipulate§məˈnɪpjuleɪt§Computers are very efficient at manipulating information.§计算机在**处理**信息方面效率极高。§
20876§juvenile§ˈdʒuːvənaɪl§Juvenile delinquency has increased remarkably in the last decade.§在过去的十年里，**未成年人**犯罪有明显的增加。§
20877§phenomenon§fəˈnɒmɪnən§The greenhouse effect is a natural phenomenon.§温室效应是一种自然**现象**。§
20878§freight§freɪt§Heavy freight could only be carried by water or rail.§大型**货物**只能通过水路或铁路来运输。§
20879§vulnerable§ˈvʌlnərəbl§Women are especially vulnerable to back pain because of pregnancy.§由于怀孕，女性尤其**容易**背痛。§
20880§steam§stiːm§The old train is powered by a steam engine.§老式火车由**蒸汽**机驱动。§改例句：可数名词单数 steam engine 前缺冠词，补 a
20881§valuable§ˈvæljuəbl§The province is abundant in valuable minerals.§该省盛产**贵重**的矿物质。§
20882§presumably§prɪˈzjuːməbli§Presumably consumers have bought such poisonous food.§消费者**很可能**已经购买了这种有毒食品。§

20883§sanctuary§ˈsæŋktʃuəri§Despite living in a sanctuary, which makes them safe from hunters, the animals still face a number of problems that threaten their survival.§尽管生活在**保护区**，得以远离猎人，但这些动物仍然面临很多威胁它们生存的问题。§
20884§request§rɪˈkwest§I'd like to make a request for leave.§我想**请求**离开一下。§
20885§dash§dæʃ§I dashed off the letter.§我**急急忙忙**地把信写完了。§
20886§treatment§ˈtriːtmənt§People were dissatisfied with the treatment of animals at the zoo.§动物园**对待**动物的方式令人不满。§
20887§coarse§kɔːs§It's good for you to walk on the coarse sand with bare feet.§光脚在**粗**沙上走动对你有好处。§
20888§insecure§ˌɪnsɪˈkjʊə(r)§The trend towards blurring these roles in dress is probably democratic, but it also makes some people very insecure.§淡化服饰角色的趋势或许比较民主，但同时也让一些人觉得很**不安全**。§
20889§linen§ˈlɪnɪn§All bed linens and towels are clearly embossed with the name of the manufacturer.§所有的**床上用品**和毛巾上都清楚地压印了生产商的名字。§
20890§inspiration§ˌɪnspəˈreɪʃn§Hypotheses arise from guesswork, or from inspiration.§假说源于人们的猜测或**灵感**。§
20891§generous§ˈdʒenərəs§People in disaster-affected areas received generous aid from the government.§受灾地区的人民从政府那里得到了**大量的**救济物资。§
20892§cultivate§ˈkʌltɪveɪt§This banana is the first type to be cultivated here.§这种香蕉是这里最早**种植**的品种。§
20893§campaign§kæmˈpeɪn§Local authorities in London campaigned to be allowed to enforce anti-pollution laws themselves.§伦敦当地政权发起一场要求赋予他们执行反污染法案权力的**运动**。§
20894§disorder§dɪsˈɔːdə(r)§The couple knew through the examination that they would have a baby free from the disorder.§通过检查，这对夫妇知道自己会生一个没有这种**疾病**的健康宝宝。§改译文：原译“健康的宝宝”没有和 disorder 对应的词，改为“没有这种疾病的健康宝宝”
20895§spot§spɒt§You'll spot the cinema right next to the underground station.§你会**发现**这家电影院就在地铁站旁边。§
20896§outcome§ˈaʊtkʌm§Some environmentalists worry about this outcome.§一些环境保护主义者对这个**结果**表示担心。§
20897§cautious§ˈkɔːʃəs§We should be more cautious not to make any mistakes in our papers.§我们要更加**小心**以避免在试卷上出现任何错误。§
20898§aggravate§ˈæɡrəveɪt§The pollution problems in the area will be further aggravated by the heavy industry.§重工业的发展将使该地区的污染问题进一步**恶化**。§
20899§deception§dɪˈsepʃn§The young boy didn't have the courage to admit his deception.§那个男孩没有勇气承认他的**欺骗**行为。§
20900§sharpen§ˈʃɑːpən§The course can help the students sharpen their oral skills.§这门课程可以帮助学生们**提高**口语表达能力。§
20901§practical§ˈpræktɪkl§The new invention was very practical.§这项新发明很**实用**。§
20902§pliable§ˈplaɪəbl§This pair of shoes is made of pliable leather.§这双鞋是用**软**皮做的。§改例句：主语中心词是 This pair，谓语应用单数 is，are 错
20903§disposal§dɪˈspəʊzl§The main use of water in most families is washing and waste disposal.§在大多数家庭中，水的主要用途是洗漱和废物**处理**。§
20904§subsidiary§səbˈsɪdiəri§Ports attract many subsidiaries and independent industries.§港口城市吸引了很多**附属公司**和独立产业。§
20905§pattern§ˈpætn§How do you think the Internet has affected buying patterns in the past few years?§你认为在过去几年内互联网如何影响了购买**模式**？§
20906§terrain§təˈreɪn§Five speed bicycles are best suited to riding over long distances or hilly terrain.§五档位变速自行车最适用于长途旅行或者崎岖多山的**地形**。§
20907§kneel§niːl§Mary knelt down to examine the damage to her car.§玛丽**跪**下来仔细查看汽车的受损情况。§
20908§overwhelm§ˌəʊvəˈwelm§The village was overwhelmed by the flood.§那个村庄被洪水**淹没**了。§
20909§contempt§kənˈtempt§The officer's tone of voice towards the stowaway was loaded with contempt.§警官对偷渡者说话的语气充满了**轻蔑**。§
20910§recognize§ˈrekəɡnaɪz§Companies should recognize that their employees are a significant part of their financial assets.§公司应该**认识到**雇员是其金融资产的重要组成部分。§
20911§badge§bædʒ§Are there any marks or badges on your briefcase that make it stand out?§你的公文包上是否有什么记号或**标记**能让它区别于其他公文包？§
20912§economic§ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk§They encouraged farmers to use greater quantities of fertilizers than are needed to get the highest economic crop yield.§他们鼓励农民使用远远超过作物实际所需量的化肥，以获得最高的**经济**作物产量。§
20913§feeble§ˈfiːbl§I felt feeble when I was ill.§我生病的时候感到很**虚弱**。§
20914§virtue§ˈvɜːtʃuː§The virtue of job descriptions is that they lessen role ambiguity.§工作描述的**优点**是能减少角色模糊性。§
20915§suburb§ˈsʌbɜːb§The hotel in Sydney's southern suburbs is the closest to Sydney Airport.§位于悉尼南**郊**的这家酒店是距离悉尼机场最近的酒店。§
20916§pulverise§ˈpʌlvəraɪz§Pulverised rock will climb as a dust cloud into the atmosphere.§**粉碎**的岩石会像尘雾一样上升到大气中。§改译文：「石粉」中 pulverise 只对应「粉」，改为「粉碎的岩石」
20917§fertilise§ˈfɜːtəlaɪz§Mature breeding birds are very expensive—even a fertilised ostrich egg isn't cheap.§这种鸟的成鸟很贵，甚至一个**受精**的鸵鸟蛋都不便宜。§
20918§ration§ˈræʃn§Eggs are on ration during the war.§战争期间，鸡蛋实行**定量供应**。§
20919§attractive§əˈtræktɪv§My landlord is a slender attractive woman in her mid-thirties.§我的房东35岁左右，身材苗条，**魅力四射**。§
20920§conquest§ˈkɒŋkwest§The king completed the conquest of the country.§国王彻底**征服**了那个国家。§
20921§sophisticate§səˈfɪstɪkət§Susan isn't the sophisticate that her classmates imagine her to be.§苏珊并不像她的同学们想的那样是个**久经世故的人**。§
20922§snap§snæp§The heavy snow storm snapped tree branches and power lines.§暴风雪**折断**了树枝和电线。§
20923§express§ɪkˈspres§The chart on the wall expresses the economic movements differently from the last year.§墙上的这张图表**反映**了经济趋势与去年的不同。§
20924§identifiable§aɪˌdentɪˈfaɪəbl§Each piece of luggage should carry an identifiable label with the owner's name and contact number.§每件行李都应贴有**可辨认的**标签，写明物主的姓名和联系电话。§补例句
20925§nominal§ˈnɒmɪnl§The bonus to employees is merely a nominal sum.§雇员们只得到了一笔**象征性**的奖金。§
20926§acquire§əˈkwaɪə(r)§In the process of evolution, monkeys have not acquired the art of speech.§在进化的过程中，猴子未能**获得**语言能力。§
20927§register§ˈredʒɪstə(r)§You must remember to bring the ID card with you when you come to register.§你来**登记**的时候一定要记得带上身份证。§
20928§extremely§ɪkˈstriːmli§Long hours of hot sunshine and searing winds give Australia an extremely high rate of evaporation.§长时间的烈日曝晒和炙热的风使澳大利亚的蒸发率**极**高。§
20929§rot§rɒt§Root rot is a serious problem in such a situation.§在这种情况下根部**腐烂**是一个很严重的问题。§
20930§ambulance§ˈæmbjələns§There is a car accident, please send an ambulance as soon as possible.§这里发生了一起车祸，请尽快派**救护车**来。§
20931§miserable§ˈmɪzrəbl§Many female patients have completely given up exercise because the pain makes them so miserable.§很多女性病人已经完全放弃了锻炼，因为疼痛让她们极其**痛苦**。§
20932§continuous§kənˈtɪnjuəs§There's a continuous video showing today about the voyages of Captain Cook.§今日将**连续**放映有关库克船长航海的录像。§
20933§crack§kræk§Viscous lava, accompanied by burning clouds of ash and gas, welled out of the volcano from cracks in its flanks.§黏稠的岩浆夹杂着燃烧的火山灰和气团，从火山侧面的**裂缝**中喷涌而出。§
20934§ripe§raɪp§When one banana is ripe, it will give off a gas which then helps all the others to ripen.§当一根香蕉**成熟**了，它便会释放出一种气体催熟其他香蕉。§
20935§vet§vet§Students who want loans are not "means tested" or "credit vetted".§想要贷款的学生不用接受家庭经济状况调查，也不用接受信用**审查**。§改例句：中文引号改为英文引号
